coverage: every frame; no gaps or overlaps
ending: I know where there's eight thousand gallons.
scope: opening part only; full chapter unchanged

shotList.cue: Danger: Danny's leg through the ceiling
shotList.transcript: Right now my leg is hanging through the ceiling over a hundred dead people, and my best friend is walking right

shotList.cue: Theo grips Danny's wrist on his right
shotList.transcript: right under it. Stop moving. I stop. Another corner

shotList.cue: Another corner breaks away
shotList.transcript: corner breaks off anyway.

shotList.cue: Radio woman asks about daughter's window
shotList.transcript: The woman on the radio asked who was in my daughter's window, and I gave her nothing. I took my thumb

shotList.cue: Danny takes thumb off radio
shotList.transcript: thumb off the button. For six years, answering that radio had been my job. A call came in, I said my name,

shotList.cue: Six years answering calls at work
shotList.transcript: name, and whoever was on the other end knew somebody was coming. Now I had to remind myself that I could leave it alone. My phone was

shotList.cue: Phone in other hand, no service
shotList.transcript: was in my other hand. No service. My mom's last message was still there, telling me the door was locked. I read it again while

shotList.cue: Mom's locked-door message; fear of saying too much
shotList.transcript: while the woman waited. I wanted somebody to talk to badly enough that I was afraid of what I might say. Across the highway,

shotList.cue: Lily's window dark after goodnight
shotList.transcript: the tenth-floor window stayed dark. Lily had already blinked three times. I'd answered.

shotList.cue: Unseen woman waits on radio
shotList.transcript: Our goodnight was over. The woman waited long enough that I could hear her breathing through the little speaker.

shotList.cue: Danny lowers volume and listens
shotList.transcript: Danny? I turned the volume down and held the radio against my ear. You still there?

shotList.cue: A faint light behind the department store rooftop door
shotList.transcript: I could see a faint light moving behind the department store's rooftop door. When I looked again, it was gone.

shotList.cue: How did you get inside?
shotList.transcript: I pressed the button. How did you get inside? A little laugh. That's a fairly rude first question. You asked me one.

shotList.cue: Vera gives her name; Danny waits
shotList.transcript: Fair enough. Vera. There. Now you have a name. I waited.

shotList.cue: Her story: asleep trying on a coat; Vera remains unseen
shotList.transcript: I was trying on a coat. Department store. Second floor. Sat down in the fitting room and fell asleep. By the time I woke up, they'd locked the place.

shotList.cue: Danny recalls checking silent staff corridor
shotList.transcript: The store had closed at nine. At midnight, I'd checked the staff corridor behind those fitting rooms. I'd heard nothing.

shotList.cue: Danny asks which coat
shotList.transcript: What coat? I asked. What? The one you were trying on.

shotList.cue: Vera mentions people eating people downstairs
shotList.transcript: Danny, there are people eating people downstairs.

shotList.cue: Her tone changes
shotList.transcript: I think we've moved beyond the returns policy. She sounded almost amused. Then her voice changed a little.

shotList.cue: Vera claims a hungry girl is with her
shotList.transcript: There's a girl up here with me. She's hungry. Have you got anything we could eat?

shotList.cue: Danny looks toward Lily's window
shotList.transcript: I looked at Lily's window again. Kept my thumb away from the button while I did it.

shotList.cue: Keeps thumb away from radio button; how old?
shotList.transcript: How old? Little. Six, perhaps. Seven. It's hard to get much out of her.

shotList.cue: He stands on the roof, hand numb
shotList.transcript: I stood on that roof until my hand went numb around the radio. Vera never asked about the window

shotList.cue: A question he cannot walk away from
shotList.transcript: window again that night. She'd found another question I couldn't walk away from.

shotList.cue: Somebody ate breakfast in a locked store
shotList.transcript: Somebody ate my breakfast while I slept inside a locked store.

shotList.cue: Two bars beside the tent, one for later
shotList.transcript: I'd put two protein bars beside the tent. One for when I woke up, one for later, because apparently I needed a system for deciding when to eat cardboard.

shotList.cue: There was one left
shotList.transcript: There was one left.

shotList.cue: Checks bag, tent and both boots
shotList.transcript: I checked the sleeping bag. Turned it inside out. Looked under the tent and inside both boots.

shotList.cue: Padlock closed, key stays on belt
shotList.transcript: At the gate, the padlock was closed. Key thirty-one was still on my belt.

shotList.cue: Counts water twice; missing bottle
shotList.transcript: I counted the water twice. A bottle was missing too. I could explain losing a protein bar.

shotList.cue: Dead friend walking past
shotList.transcript: I'd spent the night listening to my dead friend walk past, and my brain was doing its best to forget the whole thing.

shotList.cue: Lines up bars, cans and water
shotList.transcript: A bottle was harder. I lined everything up along the back wall. Bars in one row, cans in another, water underneath.

shotList.cue: Writes inventory on a receipt
shotList.transcript: Wrote the numbers on a receipt with the little pencil I used for my shift log. I hadn't written anything in that log since the first night.

shotList.cue: Tries to remember last normal log entry
shotList.transcript: For a while I sat there trying to remember the last normal entry.

shotList.cue: Ordinary shift log and ordinary annoyances
shotList.transcript: A door propped open. A car parked across two spaces. Something I'd been annoyed about.

shotList.cue: Two pulls on gate outside
shotList.transcript: Then I heard two pulls on a gate outside, and I remembered I was supposed to be counting water.

shotList.cue: Puts remaining bars inside plastic storage box
shotList.transcript: I carried the remaining bars into the stockroom and put them in a plastic storage box.

shotList.cue: Sits beside box until neck hurts
shotList.transcript: Then I sat beside it until my neck hurt. Nothing happened.

shotList.cue: Three blinks each, body shields light from department store
shotList.transcript: At nine, I went to the roof. Three blinks from Lily. Three back from me. I kept my body between the flashlight and the department store.

shotList.cue: Vera calls as he comes downstairs
shotList.transcript: Vera called as soon as I came downstairs. Any luck with supper? I haven't agreed to anything. You sound tired.

shotList.cue: Tired; watches box another hour
shotList.transcript: I am tired. Get some rest. We can talk tomorrow. I stared at the storage box for another hour.

shotList.cue: Sleeps with box beside his head; wakes
shotList.transcript: When I finally slept, I put it beside my head. When I woke again, the lid was back on.

shotList.cue: Catch not clicked shut; two bars gone
shotList.transcript: One of the catches hadn't quite clicked shut. Two more bars were gone.

shotList.cue: Someone had stood close enough to watch him sleep
shotList.transcript: Whoever was doing this had stood close enough to watch me sleep.

shotList.cue: White bag of climbing chalk
shotList.transcript: The chalk came in a little white bag from the climbing display.

shotList.cue: Spreads chalk before placing bait
shotList.transcript: I spread it around the food box, under the stockroom door, and across the narrow space between the tents.

shotList.cue: Goes back to bed with boots on
shotList.transcript: Then I went back to bed with my boots on.

shotList.cue: Waiting for someone to step in powder
shotList.transcript: That was my entire investigation. Six years in security, and I was waiting for somebody to step in powder.

shotList.cue: Fresh bar on top; rest inside box
shotList.transcript: I left a fresh bar on top of the box. The rest went inside it. I felt ridiculous setting bait with a breakfast I couldn't afford to lose.

shotList.cue: Gate is only way in he understands
shotList.transcript: But the gate was the only way in that I understood. Whoever had found another way could bring somebody else through it.

shotList.cue: Faces gap between tents
shotList.transcript: I lay facing the gap between the tents. If anybody came through there, this time I'd see them.

shotList.cue: Hears plastic bend before morning
shotList.transcript: Sometime before morning, I heard plastic bend.

shotList.cue: Gets out of sleeping bag; silence
shotList.transcript: By the time I'd got out of the sleeping bag, the store was still again.

shotList.cue: Flashlight close to floor, lights off
shotList.transcript: I left the overhead lights off and used my flashlight close to the floor.

shotList.cue: Small trainer; square gap under worn right heel
shotList.transcript: Small trainers. A worn patch under the right heel. The print had a little square of clear floor in the middle where the sole was split.

shotList.cue: Trail goes to food box and back
shotList.transcript: The trail came from behind the climbing wall display. It went to the food box. Then it went back.

shotList.cue: Moves display, finds rack bolted to wall
shotList.transcript: I moved the display a few inches. Behind it was a tall storage rack bolted to the wall.

shotList.cue: Shoeprint on shelf and painted wall
shotList.transcript: A shoeprint showed on the bottom shelf. Another was pressed against the painted wall halfway up.

shotList.cue: Hand wiped across dusty pipe
shotList.transcript: Higher still, somebody had wiped a hand across a dusty pipe. I followed the pipe with the light.

shotList.cue: Cleaner edges of one tile; looks up
shotList.transcript: One ceiling tile was cleaner around the edges than all the others. I stood there with my mouth open.

shotList.cue: Every door locked, every window intact
shotList.transcript: Every door was locked. Every window was intact. I'd checked the gates so often that morning my hand hurt.

shotList.cue: He had not looked up
shotList.transcript: I hadn't looked up once.

shotList.cue: Small white flake falls from seam
shotList.transcript: A little white flake dropped out of the seam above me.

shotList.cue: Flashlight off; someone still up there
shotList.transcript: I switched the flashlight off. Whoever was up there had seen the light. And they were still there.

shotList.cue: Waits behind display; knee stiff
shotList.transcript: I waited behind the display until my bad knee went stiff. It was barely six in the morning.

shotList.cue: Marcus rattles gate then moves on
shotList.transcript: Outside, Marcus rattled the gate and moved on.

shotList.cue: Tile lifts; fingers, head, boy lowering onto shelf
shotList.transcript: The tile lifted. Two fingers appeared, then a head, then a very skinny boy lowering himself onto the top shelf.

shotList.cue: Theo carefully steps around squeaking shelf
shotList.transcript: He moved carefully. He knew which bit of the rack squeaked. He stepped around it before his foot even touched down.

shotList.cue: Reaches box; Danny stands; bar in Theo's hand
shotList.transcript: When he reached the floor, he went straight to the box. I waited until he bent over it. Then I stood up. We looked at each other. He had a protein bar already in his hand.

shotList.cue: Oversized green collar and dusty boy
shotList.transcript: The sweatshirt hung past his fingers. There was a pale clean line around one

shotList.cue: Pale clean line around his wrist
shotList.transcript: one wrist where he'd pushed a sleeve up. Everything else about him looked as dusty as the pipe.

shotList.cue: Danny expected a grown man
shotList.transcript: I'd practised this conversation in my head while I waited. It had involved a grown man explaining himself.

shotList.cue: Boy hungry enough to eat wrapper
shotList.transcript: I hadn't practised what to do if the thief looked hungry enough to eat the wrapper.

shotList.cue: Put it down
shotList.transcript: Put it down, I said.

shotList.cue: Theo places the bar down
shotList.transcript: He put it down.

shotList.cue: Theo runs past Danny; Danny moves aside
shotList.transcript: Then he ran straight at me. I moved aside because, for a second, that's what my body thought you did when a kid ran at you.

shotList.cue: Two steps up rack, almost at pipe
shotList.transcript: He got past, took two steps up the rack, and nearly reached the pipe.

shotList.cue: Danny catches back of hoodie, stitching tears
shotList.transcript: I caught the back of his sweatshirt. He twisted so hard the stitching tore. Let go. Stop kicking. Let go.

shotList.cue: Danny lets go; Theo second shelf, one hand on pipe
shotList.transcript: I did. He stayed on the second shelf, one hand on the pipe, watching my hands. The loose shelf knocked against the wall.

shotList.cue: Both freeze; shadow pauses then passes closed gate
shotList.transcript: Somewhere outside, a shoe dragged across the floor. We both stopped breathing. A shadow passed the gate. Paused. Moved on.

shotList.cue: Boy looks hallway then Danny; don't do that again
shotList.transcript: The boy looked toward the hallway, then back at me. Don't do that again, he whispered.

shotList.cue: Danny keeps hands visible; asks his age
shotList.transcript: I wanted to tell him I was the adult and this was my store and he was stealing my food. Instead I asked how old he was.

shotList.cue: Fifteen, Theo, alone up there
shotList.transcript: Fifteen. Your name? Theo. Who else is up there? He tightened his grip on the pipe. Nobody. That's why I stay up there.

shotList.cue: Theo sits on overturned bucket by rack
shotList.transcript: I let him sit on an overturned camping bucket. He kept the rack within reach. Where do you sleep?

shotList.cue: His sleeping space beside projection room
shotList.transcript: Above the cinema. In the ceiling? There's a space beside the projection room.

shotList.cue: Four months; small shrug; discarded food
shotList.transcript: For four months? He shrugged. A tiny movement. Like he was trying to make four months smaller. How did you eat? People throw stuff out.

shotList.cue: Goes around doors; Danny looks up at tile
shotList.transcript: And the doors? I go round them. I looked up at the tile again. He pointed toward my belt.

shotList.cue: Theo points at Danny's belt; he checks doors twice
shotList.transcript: You like checking those. The keys? The doors. You do the same ones twice when you're on the phone.

shotList.cue: Danny remembers working rounds and signing log
shotList.transcript: I thought about all the nights I'd walked this building, tugged handles, signed the log, and told myself everybody was safe.

shotList.cue: Theo peels tape from trainer and presses it back
shotList.transcript: Theo peeled a strip of tape away from his trainer. Pressed it back down.

shotList.cue: He heard Danny singing in freight elevator
shotList.transcript: You sing in the freight elevator, he said. I looked at him. Usually the same song. You only know some of it.

shotList.cue: Danny looks at him; embarrassed
shotList.transcript: My face got hot. Even then. Even with everything outside, that still worked. You can't stay

shotList.cue: You can't stay here; words before decision
shotList.transcript: stay here, I said. The words came out before I'd decided what I meant by them.

shotList.cue: Thoughts of scarce food and Marcus outside gate
shotList.transcript: There were two sentences in my head. One was about food. The other was about the man who'd sat outside my gate and trusted me to know what to do.

shotList.cue: He can hardly look at gate in daylight
shotList.transcript: I could hardly look at that gate in daylight.

shotList.cue: Kid six feet from gate waits for adult to be in charge
shotList.transcript: Now this kid was sitting six feet from it, waiting for me to be in charge. I wanted somebody qualified.

shotList.cue: Only adult available
shotList.transcript: A firefighter. His dad. Any adult who'd know how to keep him alive. He was looking at the only one available.

shotList.cue: Theo stands without arguing or taking anything
shotList.transcript: Theo stood immediately. He didn't argue. Picked up nothing, because he'd brought nothing.

shotList.cue: Marcus heard at another gate
shotList.transcript: I heard Marcus at another gate down the hall. Theo heard him too.

shotList.cue: Wait; Theo waits standing beside rack
shotList.transcript: Wait, I said. He waited beside the rack.

shotList.cue: Danny reaches for drinking bottle and stops; Theo counts
shotList.transcript: I reached for a bottle, then stopped with my hand on it. Theo watched me count the ones left. How long have you got? he asked.

shotList.cue: About ten days, calculated for one person
shotList.transcript: asked. About ten days. Maybe. I was working it out for one person. He looked toward the front of the mall.

shotList.cue: Theo: I know where there's eight thousand gallons
shotList.transcript: I know where there's eight thousand gallons.
